name: 5-Persona End-to-End Audit & Precision Release
summary: Pro3DWorks v3.2.5 resolves all 81 verified findings from a five-persona end-to-end audit across an ME student, medical clinician, busy engineering manager, chief engineer (PE), and business opportunity officer: Stripe checkout polling & Shop 5-Pack licensing, WCAG AA Studio/Graphite contrast & responsive topbar, 3D issue pins & overlay captures, clinical no-cache session mode, unit-consistent tolerance/section/draft/drawing exports, curved-contact interference & Cartesian inertia rigor, symmetric alloy/temper BOM reconciliation with mandatory reviewer sign-off, and RFQ/Release report integrity.

highlights.title: Chief Engineer Metrology, Section Pro, Drawings & Release Sign-Off
highlights.text: Adds active-unit Section Pro SVG with I1/I2/Polar J, Slab cut healing, ANSI-A/B/C drawings with 4th title-block row, Cartesian inertia & radii of gyration, radial pin-in-bore interference detection, lower Float32 snap residue, strict symmetric alloy/temper BOM checks, reviewer attribution with required rationale, and tolerance/draft traceability columns.

highlights.title: Busy Manager RFQ Intake, HTML Review Reports, BOM & Revision Compare
highlights.text: Fixes [object Object] RFQ material rendering, preserves Withheld stock envelope extents, hides empty report sections cleanly, adds mass/BOM/interference/revision/PMI/repair report blocks, persists RFQ state in .p3dproject files with PDF page counts, adds BOM XLSX export from BOM Cleanup, and includes volume & envelope deltas in Revision CSV.

highlights.title: Clinician & Medical Workflow Precision, Annotations & Privacy Controls
highlights.text: Adds 3D issue pin & redline compositing onto PNG captures and Review Report covers, Surface Point picking for mesh/STL models, clinical session no-cache privacy toggle, `#no-update-check` post-wipe reload, automatic log clear on model close, explicit unitless STL warning banners with one-click Scale trigger, and WCAG AA Studio/Graphite contrast.

highlights.title: ME Student Learning Flow & Offline Basics Tutorial
highlights.text: Adds offline-first Basics tutorial, fixes Studio/Realistic tutorial display cycling, section/explode cleanup, modal shortcut isolation, Show All filter resets, expanded local palette commands (switch units, volume query, default explode, help), and zero-scroll Start Card usability at 1280×720.

highlights.title: Commercial Licensing, Stripe Key Delivery & Docs Alignment
highlights.text: Fixes post-purchase Stripe polling & paid status confirmation, adds Shop 5-Pack Monthly ($149/mo) alongside yearly/perpetual checkout, shows full copiable workstation IDs, clarifies managed offline policies, adds Free vs Pro matrix & footer navigation, and removes desktop donation chrome when licensed desktop builds run.

notes: All CAD geometry, RFQ intake, CNC DFM, DXF preflight, Release Review reconciliation, PDF-to-DXF/DWG conversions, and GPU renders run locally on your workstation — zero customer model uploads.
Managed offline mode ('no_external_network') provides technical egress controls and is not a claim of organizational ISO/IEC 27001 certification or TISAX assessment.
OpenCascade / occt-import-js (LGPL-2.1) is shipped in separate relinkable desktop files alongside LICENSE.md; see docs/SBOM.cdx.json.
